text.en:
Now you say where someone is not.
Estoy en casa. = I am at home.
No estoy en casa. = I am not at home.
No means “not”. It goes right before the changing word.
No estás en casa. = You are not at home.
Nothing else in the sentence moves.

With a name, the order is: name, no, changing word, place.
Ana no está en casa. = Ana is not at home.
Luis no está aquí. = Luis is not here.
Ana y Luis no están aquí. = Ana and Luis are not here.
No always sits just before está or están.

Next you pick the right sentence with or without “not”.
First look for no. Then look at who it is about.
No estamos en clase. = We are not in class.
La estación no está lejos. = The station is not far away.
La estación means “the station”. Lejos means “far away”.
No estoy en la tienda. = I am not in the shop.
La tienda means “the shop”.
